name: Nirogacestat Hydrobromide
summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, evaluated Nirogacestat Hydrobromide for potential health concerns [M]. This computer program gave the drug a high score of 67 for possible liver issues [M]. The same computer model gave it a low score of 30 for potential heart problems [M]. There are no other specific problems, food and drug warnings, or human trial details reported in the provided records for this drug [1][2].
